description: Replace a program's intake routing rules: where its intake agent sends a completed request on, by the reporter's answers to its choice questions. Send the WHOLE list (read the current one, and the `revision`, from anyforge_get_program's `intakeAgent.routing`); `[]` removes them all. A rule matches when every `when` condition holds, and the first match wins. Each condition must name a choice question and an answer the program's checklist offers (add a new answer with anyforge_set_program_intake_definition first), and each destination must take requests. Only the program's lead or owner may set them. Rules apply to requests completed after the change; a request already filed is not moved.

ifRevision.description: The `revision` you read; the change is refused if the program moved since.

programId.description: The program whose intake agent routes.

rules.description: The whole list of rules, in the order they are tried.

toProgramId.description: The program whose Incoming Requests a matching request is sent to.

when.description: Checklist item id → the option values that match, e.g. { "type": ["bug", "incident"], "domain": ["security"] }.

name: anyforge_set_program_intake_routing
title: Set program intake routing
